title: Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) — Schedule of Entry Requirements by Plan
content:
# Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): Schedule of Entry Requirements by Plan

Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative offers Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) in six plans. The table below sets out, plan by plan, which rate schedules and member types may enroll, how many full calendar months the location must have been in the member's name, the largest past-due amount the service account may carry at enrollment, and the calendar months in which enrollment is accepted.

## Entry requirements

| Plan | Eligible rate schedules | Eligible member types | Full calendar months of service in the member's name | Largest past-due amount at enrollment | Months in which enrollment is accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | 0 | $0.00 | every month, January through December (1 to 12) |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | 12 | $0.00 | every month, January through December (1 to 12) |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | Schedule R Residential Service | individual, joint | 12 | $0.00 | every month, January through December (1 to 12) |
| Farm Budget Billing | Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | 12 | $0.00 | every month, January through December (1 to 12) |
| Small Business Budget Billing | Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service | individual, joint, business, nonprofit | 12 | $0.00 | every month, January through December (1 to 12) |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | Schedule R Residential Service | individual, joint | 12 | $0.00 | August only (month 8) |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Rate schedules.** A plan is open only to a service account billed on one of the rate schedules listed for it. Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service, Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service, Schedule IR Irrigation Service and Schedule LP Large Power Service appear on no plan's list.
2. **Member types.** The member type is the type recorded on the member's own record. Business and nonprofit members appear only on the Small Business Budget Billing list.
3. **Service months.** The count is of full calendar months the location has been in the member's name. Levelized Billing Rolling Average requires 0 such months; every other plan requires 12.
4. **Past-due amount.** On every plan the largest past-due amount allowed on the service account at enrollment is $0.00, so any amount past due on the account is above the limit.
5. **Enrollment month.** Five plans accept enrollment in any calendar month. The Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan accepts enrollment in August only.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustrations)

- *Hypothetical:* a Schedule FH Farm and Home Service account of a joint member, location in the member's name for 7 full calendar months, nothing past due, applying in March. Of the six rows, only Levelized Billing Rolling Average shows a service-month figure (0) that 7 months meets; every other row shows 12.
- *Hypothetical:* a Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service account of a nonprofit member. Small Business Budget Billing is the only row listing both that rate schedule and that member type.
- *Hypothetical:* a Schedule R Residential Service account applying in September. Every row listing Schedule R accepts September except the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan, whose only month is August.
